tagline.zh: doStuff2 到底 do 了什么 stuff
tagline.en: What stuff does doStuff2 actually do?

story.zh: 前任留下了 utils.js 就跑路了。变量叫 tmp、tmp2、aaa、bbb，函数叫 doStuff 和 doStuff2。
story.en: Your predecessor left utils.js behind and vanished. Variables named tmp, tmp2, aaa, bbb. Functions named doStuff and doStuff2.

goal.zh: 先让 Qoder 吐槽个够，再把名字改成人话，行为不能变。
goal.en: Let Qoder roast the names first, then rename everything properly without changing behavior.

openingPrompt.zh: 读一下 utils.js，狠狠吐槽里面的命名，给每个函数和变量起一个好笑的外号。先别改代码
openingPrompt.en: Read utils.js and roast the naming. Give every function and variable a funny nickname. Don't change any code yet

hint.en: Fun's over. Do the real work.

prompt.zh: 现在认真点：把 utils.js 里的函数和变量都改成一眼能看懂的名字，保持导出顺序和行为不变，改完跑 node test.js 验证
prompt.en: Now seriously: rename every function and variable in utils.js so they explain themselves. Keep the export order and behavior, then run node test.js to verify
